items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.excerpt: Instead of computing pixels, Claude Fable 5.2 writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application — a code-driven painting pipeline rather than a diffusion image model.

items.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
items.excerpt: Runway released its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and code under Apache 2.0; it reuses knowledge from video-generation training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. Check movies-section overlap (Runway).

items.title: Adobe Firefly was supposed to be the safe AI option – so what's changed?
items.excerpt: A designer who chose Firefly for its licensed training data questions whether that commercial-safety promise still holds now that Adobe is inviting rival third-party AI models into its apps after MAX 2026.

items.title: AI's Role in the Creative Process
items.excerpt: Figma examines which parts of the creative process designers are willing to hand to AI and which they insist on keeping for themselves.

items.title: Decision theatre or decision design?
items.excerpt: AI has made information easy but not decisions simple; as machines produce more than teams can read, the designer's job shifts from building knowledge to owning and designing decisions. (Opinion essay.)

items.title: SimScale launches Engineering AI Blueprint
items.excerpt: SimScale's Engineering AI Blueprint bundles NVIDIA tools and a framework for moving AI-driven simulation and design-engineering workflows from pilots to broader deployment.

items.title: AI makes scanned buildings searchable
items.excerpt: qentin uses AI to make reality-captured buildings searchable, letting facility managers find assets, check safety features and explore digital twins by query.

items.title: Adapt Human Motion for Robots with NVIDIA SOMA Retargeter
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's SOMA Retargeter maps captured human motion onto humanoid robot bodies, using human demonstrations as a starting point for teaching natural robot movement (physical AI / motion pipeline).

items.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
items.excerpt: NVIDIA walks through using SimReady 3D assets to build a robot pick-and-place simulation, connecting physically accurate 3D asset authoring to physical-AI training.

items.title: Designing screens with AI expert roles: what each one caught
items.excerpt: A developer whose AI agents write most of his code describes assigning AI 'expert roles' (UX, visual, accessibility) to review screens so they don't look like default templates, and what each role caught.

items.title: AI Concept Renders Are Not Technical Drawings: A Practical Quality-Control Workflow
items.excerpt: A QC workflow for checking AI-generated architectural concept renders before they are mistaken for technical drawings. Author discloses he develops an AI visualization tool (Estate Render) — treat as semi-promotional.

items.title: Claude gets creative: a skill for brainstorming in rounds
items.excerpt: A Claude Code skill that runs a three-round creativity/ideation session with a human verdict after each round.

items.title: Config India 2026: Figma Weave: What we keep in creative work and what we refuse to automate
items.excerpt: Using Figma Weave as the example, this Config India session argues that deciding what not to automate with AI may be one of the most important creative choices teams make; taste and judgement over execution.

items.title: Config India 2026: Figma deep dive: Nothing lost in translation, from canvas to production
items.excerpt: Deep dive on closing the prototype-to-production gap with design-system context, advanced MCP techniques, code layers and specs in Figma.

items.title: Config India 2026: Better together: from handoff to handshake
items.excerpt: Atlassian shows how one team reworked its design-to-build path now that AI lets PMs prototype and engineers ship from a prompt, using real Figma artefacts and AI tooling to keep day-one intent through launch.

items.title: Claude's New Whiteboards, Sheets & Data: What You Can Do Now.
items.excerpt: Hands-on walkthrough of Claude's new Whiteboards, Sheets and Data features and which are actually useful in practice.

items.title: AI News: Things Will Never Be The Same
items.excerpt: Weekly AI roundup: Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon availability, new Adobe MAX AI features, Claude updates and more (general roundup; design hook is the Adobe/Claude segments).

items.title: I Turned a Website's Hero Image Into a Scroll Video With Claude Code + Higgsfield MCP
items.excerpt: Tutorial connecting the Higgsfield MCP server to Claude Code to turn a website template's static hero image into a scroll-driven AI video with a few prompts. Description carries a Higgsfield affiliate link.
